verdict.rationale: Factory documents delegating tasks to Droid, which investigates, implements and tests issue work, then lets you review the diff and merge. Missions add planning with features, milestones and success criteria for larger multi-feature work. The docs say Droid will "test the work" but never explicitly say it writes new test files, so the test-authoring part of the story is only implied. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the agent writes new tests as part of a feature, independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end feature delivery.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have an agent implement a requested feature end-to-end, including writing tests

citations.quote: Assign a Linear issue to Factory or mention `@Factory` in an issue comment to have Droid investigate, implement, and test the work.
Assign a Jira issue to Factory or mention `@Factory` in an issue comment to have Droid investigate, implement, and test the work.
Delegate a task, review the diff, and merge from the App or your terminal.
Work with Droid to define features, milestones, and success criteria before any code is written.
Use Factory Missions to plan and execute large, multi-feature projects with structured orchestration.
